theme_and_archetype.primary_archetype: Archetype 5: Luxury (with local Nepali heritage touch)
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Trust, Heritage, Premium Quality, Local Grounding

public_site.rules: Tight tracking on large headings (tracking-tighter). Elegant serifs to emphasize heritage.

admin_dashboard.rules: Geometric sans for data clarity. Avoid Inter for headings.

public_site.grid: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A: The Tetris Grid). Mix col-span-4 and col-span-8.
public_site.spacing: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12, p-16. Gap strategy: gap-8 to gap-12.
public_site.hero: Max overlay opacity bg-black/40. Let the gold jewellery shine.

admin_dashboard.grid: Mode B: The Control Room Grid. 3 to 4 columns.
admin_dashboard.spacing: Tight spacing for density. gap-4, gap-6. Cardless or 1px minimal borders.

components_strategy.buttons: Large touch targets (min-h-[48px]). Dark Navy primary buttons with subtle Gold hover text or borders. No pill shapes, use rounded-md or rounded-none for a crisp look.
components_strategy.cards: Public: Glassmorphism over textures (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px border-white/40). Admin: Flat solid bg-white, 1px border-slate-200, no shadow unless hovered.
components_strategy.forms: Simple, stacked labels. Large inputs for non-technical staff. Shadcn UI Input/Select/Form but customized with larger text and hit areas.
components_strategy.navigation: Public: Sticky header with Crystal Glass effect. Desktop links visible, WhatsApp CTA prominent. Admin: Left sidebar on desktop, bottom bar or hamburger on mobile.
components_strategy.tables: Shadcn UI Tables. Clean, no zebra striping, just subtle bottom borders. Action menus clearly visible.

motion_and_interactions.hover: -translate-y-1 on cards. Explicit hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white on buttons.
motion_and_interactions.lists: Staggered entrance animations for catalogue items.

media_and_assets.icons: lucide-react (default). Use 1.5 stroke width for elegant, airy feel.

images.description: Gold metallic foil texture for luxurious header or banner backgrounds.
Gold necklace with pearls on a red background. Perfect for Nepali traditional context.
Traditional jewelry portrait for About/Trust section.

domain_specific_rules.language_and_localization: Must support Nepali numerals and Bikram Sambat (BS) dates on bills and public rates.
domain_specific_rules.pricing_engine_ui: Admin product CRUD needs explicit, clear fields for Tola, Jarti (wastage), and Jyala (making charge) computation.
domain_specific_rules.whatsapp_first: Every public product detail page must have a 'WhatsApp Enquiry' CTA as the primary action, pre-filling a message with the item name/ID.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY. All buttons, forms, links, and key rate displays MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-enquiry-button', data-testid='today-gold-rate').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure Dark Navy text on Ivory background exceeds 4.5:1. Never use transparent text or buttons without clear outlines.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Implement the public marketing site using custom HTML/Tailwind structures (avoid Shadcn Cards to allow for overlapping/artistic asymmetry).
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Implement the Admin Dashboard using heavily customized Shadcn UI for data density and ease-of-use for non-tech users.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Prioritize the Today's Gold/Silver Rate widget as it's the anchor of the app. Ensure it has a dedicated data-testid.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Make sure the layout scales flawlessly to mobile, as this is a mobile-first requirement.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT use placeholder images. Use the provided Unsplash URLs from media_and_assets.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: CRITICAL: The codebase uses .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write all React components in JavaScript with PropTypes or JSDoc if types are needed.
